_provenance: The UWeatherSubsystem storm/gust cadence as a trainable domain. The genome IS the WIND table; the objective binds the Law-4 tension: storms must erase often enough to ACHE and rarely enough that footprints MATTER. Both failure modes are measurable.

walls.storm_interval_days_min: The shortest gap between storms MUST be at least 1 day. Below 1 day means storms chain-endlessly — the player never sees calm weather, and footprints never survive long enough to matter. The 'too often' failure mode of Law 4.
walls.sand_erasure_fraction_min: Every storm MUST erase sand footprints. The vision's mechanic is unconditional: 'every footprint whose surface is not METAL is wiped'. Below 0.90 means the simulated mechanic does not match the shipped one. This is expected to sit near 1.0 — it is an audit, not a tuned number.
walls.longest_footprint_lifetime_days: The longest-living footprint MUST survive at least half a day. Below 0.5 days means even the freshest track is gone by the next storm — the player can never return to their own path. The 'too rare' failure mode of Law 4.
walls.lifetime_period_ratio: Mean footprint lifetime MUST be between 1% and 25% of the mean storm interval. Below 1% means footprints are vaporized — they never accumulate. Above 25% means storms are so rare that the entire landscape is a permanent scrapbook. Both are the Law-4 tension collapsed to one side.
walls.dead_calm_fraction_worst: Dead calm MUST stay below 60% of non-storm time. Above 60% means the world is perceptually static — no breeze, no gust — for most of the player's experience. The weather system's job is to be FELT, not to be absent.
walls.storm_time_fraction_worst: Permanent storm MUST NOT exceed 10% of total time. Above 10% means the player spends more than 1 in 10 hours in a storm — the world is hostile by default, and the storm mechanic loses meaning.
walls.robustness: The shortest storm interval MUST be at least 15% of the mean. Below 0.15 means the cadence has a pathological outlier — one restart drew a 0.5-day gap while the mean is 7 days. The player does not experience the mean; they experience the worst draw.
